about: Texts of materialist dialectics downloaded on Ren's word ('can download', 10 November 2026) for TM's dialectics pilot. The files are kept on Ren's machine in this folder and are not committed: the Chinese text of 《矛盾论》 and the English translations may still be under copyright, and whether to commit them is Ren's. Each was read in part, as its reading_scope says; passages were found by search, not by reading every page.

files.preservation: Original HTTP response body, unmodified; an electronic edition, not collated with a printed one.
files.reading_scope: Read in full but its last paragraph's end and notes.
